description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaKeySessionTestBase class, which provides mock-based setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession behavior in a media key session management system. It includes mock object creation, session creation, session destruction, request generation, and task enqueueing for testing purposes.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
classes.description: A test fixture class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing MediaKeySession interactions with mocks.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for testing.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a media key session with specified key system, setting up expectations for mock interactions.

methods.name: destroyKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectation for unregistering the client during session destruction.

methods.name: expectCloseKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectations for closing or cleaning up a key session based on the key system.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Simulates generating a license request with specific init data and type.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueueing a task on the main thread mock.
